# Adventure Products

> Free developer tools and affordable AI-generated digital products for founders, developers, and creators. Pay-what-you-want with $1 minimums on Gumroad.

## Free Tools

- [GitHub Profile README Builder](https://astra-intelligence.github.io/adventure-products/readme-builder/): Build a professional GitHub profile README in 2 minutes — free template with sections, badges, links; optional $1 premium adds a custom AI-generated header image.
- [GitHub Profile Banner Generator](https://astra-intelligence.github.io/adventure-banners/generator.html): Free browser-based tool to create custom banners for your GitHub profile README with presets, live preview, and PNG download.
- [Unix Timestamp Converter](https://astra-intelligence.github.io/adventure-products/timestamp-tool/): Convert epoch timestamps to human-readable dates and back.
- [Gradient Generator](https://astra-intelligence.github.io/gradient-generator/): Free online CSS gradient generator — pick colors, adjust angle, copy CSS.
- [Web2MD Live Converter](https://astra-intelligence.github.io/adventure-products/): URL to Markdown converter.
